title: IdentityProviderRuntimeProfile
description: Secret-free identity-runtime verification profile attached to an existing CapabilityProvider and EngineInstance. It is not a replacement provider, binding, topology, health or entitlement model. CP owns platform provider lifecycle/bindings/placement; approved IAM security/configuration references supply additional identity policy. A profile never establishes ACTIVE, HEALTHY, entitlement or canonical workload activation.

configuration_reference.description: CP ExternalReference for versioned, approved non-secret runtime configuration; must not resolve to credential values. Provider-native details remain outside this profile.

security_domain_reference.description: CP ExternalReference to approved IAM IdentitySecurityDomain policy configuration. Target type and ownership must be verified by the consumer. A realm, tenant, organisation, email domain or region does not imply this relationship.

artifact_digest.description: Exact artifact the observations describe. Must agree with the approved EngineInstance release; copying a digest into this profile does not approve or prove a deployment.

capability_observations.description: At most one observation per runtime facet; uniqueness by capability is a semantic invariant, including observations with different statuses.

revision.description: Monotonic approved profile revision; consumers reject rollback and stale publication under governed policy.
